rationale: The paper 2303.17682 investigates the prediction of the z-component of the magnetic field within coronal mass ejections, which directly relates to the question of why forecasting magnetic vectors remains elusive. It provides new evidence by exploring machine learning techniques for prediction, contributing to understanding the challenges in forecasting.
